headline: Diffusion graph of 11 analysed items: 4 rated likely synthetic, 0 partly synthetic, 2 likely authentic, 5 inconclusive. Displayed 11 of 11 eligible (11 source items). Excluded: 0 non-image, 0 unreadable, 0 duplicate, 0 filtered. Isolated shown: 0.
caption: Diffusion graph of 11 analysed items. Each point is an analysed item, and lines connect items with similar verdicts and ratings, or near-duplicate pixels. The analysis rated four as likely synthetic, zero as partly synthetic, and two as likely authentic, and five inconclusive, so they read 4 of the 11 as at least partly synthetic. The items form a single connected group. Within the graph, three items act as bridges, connecting parts that would otherwise sit apart: one fully synthetic. Items rated fully synthetic form most of the links between groups here. This is a similarity map of the analysed set. Distribution history: not assessed. Displayed 11 of 11 eligible (11 source items). Excluded: 0 non-image, 0 unreadable, 0 duplicate, 0 filtered. Isolated shown: 0. Separate audio/vendor observations accompany one item(s); they are recorded separately from the ratings and similarity links. AI-origin detection from sound is outside this workflow.
paragraph: Diffusion graph of 11 analysed items. Each point is an analysed item, and lines connect items whose analysis results are similar, or whose pixels are near-duplicates. The analysis rated four as likely synthetic, zero as partly synthetic, and two as likely authentic, and five inconclusive, so they read 4 of the 11 as at least partly synthetic. The items form a single connected group. Within the graph, three items act as bridges, connecting parts that would otherwise sit apart: one fully synthetic. The links between the groups run mainly through these bridging items, which is where the groups meet in this similarity map. In this sample, the items rated fully synthetic, not the partly altered ones, do most of the connecting. This is a similarity map of the analysed set. Distribution history: not assessed. Displayed 11 of 11 eligible (11 source items). Excluded: 0 non-image, 0 unreadable, 0 duplicate, 0 filtered. Isolated shown: 0. Separate audio/vendor observations accompany one item(s); they are recorded separately from the ratings and similarity links. AI-origin detection from sound is outside this workflow.
